content.short: Kurtosis is a leading development and testing tool for building distributed systems.
content.description: Since its founding in 2020 by Galen Marchetti and Kevin Today, Kurtosis has served as a tool for developing and testing distributed systems. Designed to streamline the creation and iteration of development and testing environments, it helps web3 teams build robust distributed architectures more efficiently. Kurtosis aims to be a state-of-the-art developer tool that enables engineers across the ecosystem to ship software at scale with greater confidence and reliability, from experimentation to production readiness.
